summary: Chesterfield County lookout tower; the only dated note is a 1944-45 paint job. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: Observation tower of lattice construction (OpenStreetMap tags)

events.note: Painted, per the state commission's report for July 1, 1944 to June 30, 1945

evidence.supports: Ruby is listed under the South Carolina Forestry Commission
The Ruby tower was painted in the July 1944 to June 1945 report period
evidence.quote: 1944-45: The Ruby fire tower was painted. (Report of the State Commission of Forestry, 7/1/44 to 6/30/45)

evidence.supports: The Commission's first tower went up near Camden in August 1930
evidence.quote: The first Forestry Commission fire tower was erected in August, 1930 near Camden

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 1944-45 paint note and OpenStreetMap tags only. Two searches and about five reads found no Ruby-specific history, build date, height, staffing, current status or access. The Chesterfield County location matches the brief. The OSM elevation is not used.
